identificationModule.officialTitle: Comparison of the Pathological Effect Between 2 and 4 Cycles Neoadjuvant CAPOX for Low/Intermediate Risk II/III Rectal Cancer：a Prospective, Non-inferior, Randomized, Controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To compare the pathological effect between 2 cycles and 4 cycles of Capox regimen as neoadjuvant chemotherapy for low/ intermediate risk stage II/III rectal cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy alone has showed much benefit for low/ intermediate risk stage II/III rectal cancer which would be verified by the PROSPECT trial. However, the effect of the Neoadjuvant chemotherapy was heterogeneous in different patients. It's important to verify those chemo-resistant cases as early as possible. So that, this trial will compare the pathological effect between 2 cycles and 4 cycles of Capox regimen as neoadjuvant chemotherapy for low/ intermediate risk stage II/III rectal cancer to explore whether those chemotherapeutic non-responders after 2 cycles Capox was non-inferior to those after 4 cycles chemotherapy.

armGroups.label: 2 cycles group
armGroups.description: patients which recruited have 2 cycles Capox regimen (oxaliplatin: 130 mg/m2 iv d 1, capecitabine: 1000 mg/m2 bid d 1-14, repeated at 3 week intervals), then those patients with no sever chemotheraputic AE, have TME operation after reevaluation and randomization.

armGroups.label: 4 cycles group
armGroups.description: patients which recruited have 2 cycles Capox regimen (oxaliplatin: 130 mg/m2 iv d 1, capecitabine: 1000 mg/m2 bid d 1-14, repeated at 3 week intervals), then those patients with no sever chemotheraputic AE, have two more cycles chemotherapy and TME operation after reevaluation and randomization.

interventions.name: Capox chemotherapy
interventions.description: oxaliplatin: 130 mg/m2 iv d 1, capecitabine: 1000 mg/m2 bid d 1-14, repeated at 3 week intervals
